planted_inconsistencies.description: Medication prescribed despite a documented intolerance
planted_inconsistencies.note: A ciprofloxacin intolerance is documented, but ciprofloxacin is prescribed.
The patient is described as afebrile throughout the stay, but fever is documented at admission.
